title: Building – Secondary Suite – March 2024
description: A City SCO issued an order requiring the owner to upgrade and permit a basement as a secondary suite built without permits. The SCO's grounds included a basement bedroom, a toilet room, an unplugged toaster oven, a microwave in the garage, and an exterior side entrance.

refusal.basis: not applicable: appeal of an order under Safety Codes Act s.49, not a refusal

outcome_summary: Order revoked: the SCO lacked reasonable and probable grounds, since the presence of features common to finished basements is not evidence of a suite.

article_mapping.source_code: Building Code (edition not stated in decision)
article_mapping.unmapped_reason: The decision does not name the code edition.
